payload.title: File:Qianjiangsaurus changshengi (partial skull, CIP V0002).png
payload.credit_html: "First report of a hollow cranial crest in an early-diverging duck-billed dinosaur, with implications for convergent evolution of acoustic signaling"
payload.description_html: Photograph (A) and drawing (B) of the two-dimensionally displayed partial skull of Qianjiangsaurus changshengi except for the braincase (CIP V0002) from one side of the plaster casing. Photograph (C) and drawing (D) of the same skull from the other side of the plaster casing. Scale bar equals 10 cm.
